title: Woman in Kyrgyzstan Alleged a Former Classmate Used an AI Bot to Create a Nude Image From Her Instagram Photo
summary: A 23-year-old woman in Kyrgyzstan said a former classmate used a Telegram AI bot to create a nude image from her Instagram photo without consent; it reached his contacts. She reported reputational and psychological harm. He acknowledged bot use but attributed circulation to a hack of his Telegram account. Creation timing and responsibility for sharing remain disputed.
